projects.title: Task Management Application
projects.description: A full-stack web application for managing tasks and projects with user authentication, real-time updates, and collaborative features. Built with modern web technologies and responsive design principles.

projects.title: E-Commerce Platform
projects.description: A comprehensive online shopping platform featuring product browsing, shopping cart functionality, order management, and payment integration. Implemented secure authentication and admin dashboard.

projects.title: Weather Dashboard
projects.description: An interactive weather application that provides real-time weather information, forecasts, and location-based data visualization. Features a clean, intuitive interface with responsive design.

projects.title: Algorithm Visualizer
projects.description: An educational tool that visualizes popular sorting and searching algorithms in real-time. Helps students understand algorithm behavior through interactive animations and step-by-step execution.

projects.title: Student Portal System
projects.description: A comprehensive student management system with features for course registration, grade tracking, assignment submission, and communication between students and faculty. Built as a team project.

projects.title: Personal Finance Tracker
projects.description: A budgeting application that helps users track expenses, set financial goals, and visualize spending patterns through interactive charts and reports. Features data export and budget alerts.
